chunks: Ibn Faḍḍāl narrated from Yūnus ibn Yaʿqūb, who said:
I said to Abū ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام about a man in ihram fastening the money-belt around his waist. He said: "Yes, and what better use is there for it after his expenditure?"

key_terms.ٱلْمُحْرِمِ: a person who has entered the state of ihram
key_terms.ٱلْهِمْيَانَ: a money-belt or pouch for carrying expenses

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible for a person in ihram to wear a money-belt around the waist?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning what a person in ihram may wear or use. Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام permits fastening a money-belt around the waist, indicating its practical benefit for keeping one's expenses and belongings.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2645 - Ibn Faddal narrated from Yunus ibn Ya'qub, who said:

I asked Abu Abdullah (as) about a Muhrim tying a belt (himyan) around his waist.
Imam (as) said: "Yes, and what is better than securing his money?"
